title: Claim Laundering: When Agent Decision Models Trust Records Over Reality
why: Decision models on Android screen traces and WebShop trust their own action records over observations after silent failures; studies state tracking in the action loop.

title: CUA-Lite: An Open Platform for Computer Use Agents
why: Open platform unifying 12 desktop, browser and mobile benchmarks, VM-free OSWorld sandboxes, CUA datasets and per-model harnesses shared by evaluation, RL and SFT.

title: VeriCUA: Learning Proactive Verification for Reliable GUI Agent Rewards
why: Learned proactive verifier that interacts with the post-execution GUI to decide what to check and when to stop; changes reward/verification for CUA RL.

title: ScopeMem: Latent Memory That Learns Where to Revise Frozen GUI Agents
why: Latent prefix memory for frozen VLM GUI agents on Android, trained to revise wrong actions while preserving correct ones; changes the memory component.

title: Tandem: Serving Hybrid Linear-Attention GUI Agents on Mobile NPUs
why: On-device runtime for smartphone GUI agents with hybrid linear-attention models on mobile NPUs; changes inference/serving of the perceive-act loop.

title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
why: Synthesizes executable environments and tasks supporting GUI, MCP and CLI for training computer-use agents with open models; environment synthesis for training.

title: Web Agent Agentic Reinforcement Learning Decision Model Under Multi-Cost and Failure Risk
why: Constrained agentic RL for web agents unifying page access, search and API calls under cost budgets and CVaR risk; changes policy training objective.

title: How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies
why: Scaling laws for agentic RL data over task, environment and trajectory axes, fitted across web and UI application domains among others; training data synthesis.

title: From Seeing to Reporting: A Theory of Reliable Visual Set Generation in Vision-Language Models
why: Theory and inference procedures for how VLMs report visual sets, including screen parsing and GUI grounding click targets; changes grounding output readout.

title: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
why: FocusGUI adapter prioritizes omni-modal channels (screenshots, audio, video, history) per step for GUI agents; changes perception to avoid sequential distraction.

title: Comparing Computer Use Behavior Across Multiple Levels of Abstraction
why: Hierarchical action parsing maps human and agent computer-use traces to shared abstraction levels for comparison; evaluation/analysis of GUI interaction traces.

title: Step-Aligned Script Generation with Verification and Recovery for Web Automation Testing
why: Browser agent converts natural-language test intent into replayable Playwright scripts with step-level grounding, verification and repair; web action execution and recovery.

title: Safe, or Simply Incapable? Rethinking Safety Evaluation for Phone-Use Agents
why: PhoneSafety benchmark of 700 risky moments across 130+ apps separating safe choice from inability for phone-use agents; safety evaluation.

title: Rethinking Vision in Computer-Use Agents (experiment code, OSWorld-V2)
why: Ablates desktop agents on OSWorld-V2: screenshot-only atomic GUI actions vs code actions with or without pixels; tests perception and action-space choices.

title: axuse: accessibility-first browser and computer use MCP server
why: Browser/desktop agents observe and act through DOM, accessibility tree and CDP instead of screenshot loops; changes perception and action interface.
